topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got home to find a package on my doorstep, and it's clear it wasn't meant for me. The name on the label is someone else's—must belong to the person who lived here before. I opened it a bit, just to see what it was, thinking maybe it was important. It looked like some personal stuff, nothing really valuable. I should call the sender or try to find the right person. Maybe I'll leave a note on the box, explaining the mistake. It wouldn’t be right to keep it, even though it would be easier. I’ll have to take some time to sort this out, but it’s the least I can do.
